questions.stem: -40 Choose the correct letter, A, B, or С. 31. What does the lecturer provide for those who are interested in doing extra reading?

options.text: Personal consultation sessions.
Extra materials, such as a booklist.
Mid-term examination. D Free glasses.

questions.stem: In the past, time management meant you needed to

options.text: reduce your stress.
plan for every hour of the week.
own a good watch. D set goals and try to achieve these goals.

questions.stem: Today, wise time management means you need to

options.text: set goals and work in a systematic way.
work faster.
set an overview of your assignment. D make a list, plan for everything and try to stick to this plan.

questions.stem: In this college, students are assigned ____________ at the end of each semester.

options.text: team projects.
final term examinations.
essays. D time management courses.

questions.stem: One sign he lecturer mentions that students feel under pressure is

options.text: library books go missing.
students get angry for no reason.
lower class attendance rates. D trouble at the library.

questions.stem: What kind of suggestion does the lecturer give to the students?

options.text: Making a very detailed plan of their daily activities.
Not being so stressed just because there is an assignment.
A regular one-hour session in their personal timetables. D Wearing comfortable shoes.

questions.stem: According to the lecturer, there are three kinds of planners. They are:

options.text: one weekly planner, one daily planner and one hour planner.
one yearly planner, one weekly planner and one daily planner.
one term planner, one monthly planner and one weekly planner. D one term planner, one weekly and one daily planner.

questions.stem: If you want to set an overview of your time, you should need at least

options.text: one week.
half a week.
one month. D one term.

questions.stem: The daily planner of time is mainly concerned with

options.text: the detailed planning.
how to plan all available time.
TV schedules. D an overview of everything you need to do for several days.

questions.stem: According to the lecturer, wise time management may have the following benefit:

options.text: having more time to spend on relaxation and other activities.
improving your performance in the final term assignment.
helping you write better essays. D improving your memory.
